thread:
Maria CSM: Reminder 8am PT tomorrow is StellarHealth QBR. Need a tight section on token econ + onboarding blockers. Quick sync here.

Raj FinOps: Sharing a short spending snapshot to include on the cost slide: 
```
This month (est): 2.15M tokens
Rate: $2.38 per 1k tokens
Spend: ~$5.1k/mo
Delta: +42% month-over-month (embeds + nightly analytics)
Note: Billing alert on 2025-03-14, spike aligns with onboarding batch.
```

Anna CS: Onboarding status: 85% done. Left: API key rotation, final integration smoke test, and a prompt walkthrough request from their ML lead. Theyre upbeat if latency drops.

Ethan Support: We saw repeated 429s on embeddings around the spike window. Retried requests created heavier traffic. I can implement client-side backpressure and stagger the nightly job.

Lisa Enable: I can run a 25-minute prompt-cost clinic ahead of the QBR (focused on reduce tokens per call). Available Mon 2pm PT. Will draft two examples: one low-cost, one high-fidelity.

Raj FinOps: Two items for the QBR slide: confirm deployment type and any known heavy routes. If they're hosted, recommend batching/caching + model variant for analytics job.

Maria CSM: Theyre on hosted; a couple of endpoints are dedicated for PHI. Biggest cost is the nightly re-embedding pipeline (~500k docs).

Anna CS: Proposal: trial a 4-bit quantized model for the analytics pipeline. Expected: ~30% cost reduction, better throughput. I'll run A/B tests and capture token/time metrics.

Ethan Support: I'll gate the nightly to smaller chunks and add exponential backoff to reduce 429 cascade. Pushing patch to staging tonight.

Raj FinOps: If quant looks promising, Ill model the before/after spend for the deck. Anna, need a 12-hour sample of tokens/sec and avg latency.

Anna CS: On it  will post numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Lisa Enable: Preparing slides + invite for the enablement session. Will include cost-friendly prompt patterns and a short checklist for the customer.

OpsBot: Billing alert forwarded: "Usage exceeded projected threshold by 38% on 2025-03-14". Ticket BILL-9342 created.

Maria CSM: Action list: 1) Anna: quant A/B sample (ETA: tomorrow 6pm PT) 2) Ethan: staging patch + prod roll early AM (ETA: prod 8am PT) 3) Raj: cost delta modeling for QBR (ETA: tomorrow 4pm PT) 4) Lisa: enablement deck + invite (Mon 2pm PT) 5) Maria: consolidate deck and send calendar invite. Ping here if blockers.

Raj FinOps: Also recommend calling out the nightly re-embed as a renewal risk driver and propose a mitigation - either scheduled off-peak runs or reserved capacity for that job.

Maria CSM: Good call. I'll add that to the risks slide and the proposed mitigations.

Anna CS: Posting sample run numbers once available.

Ethan Support: Staging tests green. Will proceed with prod deploy pending small verification.

Lisa Enable: Slides uploaded to the shared drive and invite sent.

Maria CSM: Thanks team :thumbsup:
